correctness.rationale: Projection matrices on the two orthogonal coordinate blocks give F_Q(t)=f1(t)/s1(t)+f2(t)/s2(t)=G(t)/(s1*s2) with s1=1+t^2+t^4 and s2=1+t^2+t^4+t^6, coprime, product L degree10. For any Q the derivative numerator H=G_prime*L-G*L_prime has degree at most 18 after the highest terms cancel. The explicit data Q0=diag(aa^T/14,bb^T/30), a=(1,2,3), b=(1,2,3,4), are genuine rank-one block idempotents and jointly rank2. Independent exact SymPy rational arithmetic confirmed H degree18, leading coefficient -58/35, gcd(G,L)=gcd(H,L)=gcd(H,H_prime)=gcd(H,p1*p2)=1. Thus there are 18 simple finite nonpole critical roots; the last gcd excludes the algebraic cut locus via rank(QP)=2 iff p1*p2 nonzero for this witness, and degree18 excludes criticality at infinity. Nonvanishing coefficient/resultant/discriminant conditions define a nonempty Zariski open subset of the irreducible projection Grassmannian, so generic constrained Q realizes 18. The known ED upper bound is attained, establishing GDdeg=EDdeg=18.
